noRecordFound.symptom: IF node always goes to FALSE branch
possibleCauses: URL normalization mismatch between API and CSV parser
Record status already changed from 'pending' to something else
Timing issue - record not yet committed to database when query runs
solutions: Add logging in Query node to see what URLs are being searched
Check if URL from CSV matches exactly what API created
Add small delay (100-200ms) before query to ensure transaction commits
Verify Update node is connected in workflow
Check recordId expression matches queried record
Verify Supabase service key has UPDATE permission on audits table
Check N8N execution logs for UPDATE node errors

possibleCauses: Old INSERT node not fully removed
solutions: Verify '📝 Create Individual Prospect' node is deleted
Check if other workflows might be creating records
Deactivate and reactivate workflow to clear cache
Check workflow execution history to see which nodes ran

steps: 8. Run cleanup query to reset stuck records
rollbackProcedure.cleanupQuery:
UPDATE audits
SET status = 'pending', updated_at = NOW()
WHERE audit_type = 'batch'
  AND status = 'processing'
  AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes';
